text:
mason.ops: Heads up — Hyperlane flagged customs hold on H200 crate AWB-EU-11258: missing refurb certificate. They estimate paperwork clears in ~12 days. Option to split-air 8 units (expedite) or keep full sea hold (+10-14d).

sara.procurement: Are the 8 earmarked for any Dedicated pools?

mason.ops: Yes: 6 -> eu-dedicated-3, 2 -> test-edge. Air quote €38.5k. Sea no surcharge but delayed. Vendor requires RMA reconciliation and serial manifest to release split-air.

engina-rt: If eu-dedicated-3 loses 6 GPUs, throughput dips ~22% for committed tenants. Mitigation options: (A) cross-region failover to us-east, (B) quantized fallbacks for non-critical routes, (C) throttle burst capacity. Need quick decision.

leo-platform: Failover feasible but p50 latency increases ~90-110ms for EU users. Recurring cost for egress/ops ~€12k/mo if traffic shifted persistently. Also ensure autoscaler doesn't overprovision during failover.

procurement-bot: Hyperlane update: RMA HL-8125 created. Link: https://hyperlane.example.com/rma/hl-8125. Split-air option available subject to serial reconciliation and pre-shipment manifest photos.

mason.ops: Vendor also flagged 1 DOA in inspection sample. They suggest either an immediate DOA credit or mark DOA on arrival and process RMA. If we pay air, insist on upfront credit for DOA unit.

sara.procurement: I'll ask for (a) reduced air to €25k if they provide a €20k invoice credit OR (b) cover customs broker fee (€1.2k) + serial manifest photos and timestamps. Also request commitment for 15% extra allocation next month as leverage.

clara-legal: Any credit offer must be documented in a PO amendment. No waivers on serial manifest / photos. If they want us to waive DOA claims, Legal will not sign.

engina-rt: Ops runbook notes: pre-warm plan — cordon node, start runtime, run prime calls to rebuild KV caches. Example: `systemctl start inference && curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/prime -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'` — expect 2-4h per node. Stagger arrivals 2/day to limit impact.

leo-platform: Also request vendor provide ETA per serial so we can auto-tag nodes on receipt and trigger pre-warm. If vendor refuses serial timeline, we lose ability to automate.

mason.ops: Action items: 1) Sara -> negotiate price/credit and demand serial manifest + photos; 2) Engina -> webhook to tag serials and pre-warm job; 3) Leo -> quick cost/impact sim comparing air vs SLA refund risk; 4) Clara -> PO amendment template; 5) Procurement-bot -> log RMA.

procurement-bot: Logged: {"rma":"HL-8125","awb":"AWB-EU-11258","status":"customs_hold","notes":"split_air_option_8_units"}

sara.procurement: Vendor replied: "can reduce air to €28k if you accept staggered pickup and sign waiver delaying DOA claims until arrival." Not acceptable to Legal. Pushing for written photo manifest + upfront DOA credit.

engina-rt: If vendor won't do upfront credit, prioritize reserving 2 loaner GPUs from our US pool for 72h and enable quantized fallback for 20% of non-critical routes. That buys time without paying premium.

leo-platform: I'll run the SLA-impact sim and post numbers shortly. If projected refund exposure > €28k we should accept air with strict manifest/photo requirements.

mason.ops: Good. Keep this channel for updates. If Sara confirms credit/manifest, we will schedule staggered arrivals and ops will prep pre-warm windows.
